== Summary ==
Identified: none. Ferry table; the player's face is cropped at the chin. The grey shirt with blue and white chest stripes is the same shirt and build as the unlabeled teammate at right in [[:File:2023 European Championship Team Wales 1.jpg]] and at left in [[:File:2023 European Championship Team Wales 4.jpg]], and the same man as the ship's-wheel traveler in [[:File:2022 European Championship Team Wales 1.jpg]]. Faces unlabeled.
